parts.name: Cabinet Frame
parts.Basic_description: The cabinet frame forms the main structural body of the storage cabinet, made of plywood panels.
parts.Functional_description: It provides structural support and defines the overall shape of the cabinet, holding all other parts together.
parts.Movement_description: It is a fixed, non-moving part that supports the doors, shelves, and base.

parts.name: Cabinet Base
parts.Basic_description: The cabinet base is the bottom panel of the cabinet, made of plywood for stability.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the weight of stored items and maintains the cabinet’s balance on the floor.
parts.Movement_description: It is a stationary part that does not move during normal use.

parts.name: Shelf
parts.Basic_description: The shelf is a horizontal panel inside the cabinet, made of plywood.
parts.Functional_description: It divides the internal space into sections for organized storage of items.
parts.Movement_description: It is typically fixed or adjustable but not designed for frequent movement.

parts.name: Cabinet Door (Left)
parts.Basic_description: The left cabinet door is a wooden panel attached to the frame with hinges.
parts.Functional_description: It allows access to the interior of the cabinet and protects stored items from dust.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates about its hinges to open and close.

parts.name: Cabinet Door (Right)
parts.Basic_description: The right cabinet door is a wooden panel similar to the left door, attached with hinges.
parts.Functional_description: It provides access to the right side of the cabinet and secures the contents inside.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates about its hinges to open and close.
